headline: RECORD 45% OF CENTRAL BANKS PLAN TO INCREASE GOLD HOLDINGS — GOLD NOW SURPASSES US TREASURIES AS WORLD'S LARGEST RESERVE ASSET
snippet: The World Gold Council's 2026 Central Bank Gold Reserves Survey, published June 16, found a record 45% of central bank reserve managers plan to increase their own gold holdings over the next 12 months — up from 43% in 2025 — while 89% expect global central bank gold holdings to rise. Gold has now surpassed US Treasuries as the world's largest reserve asset. The trend is concentrated in emerging markets, where 53% of central banks expect to expand reserves versus just 18% in advanced economies, and 74% of respondents expect the US dollar's share of global reserves to decline moderately or significantly over five years. The structural demand floor confirmed by this survey — central banks accumulating as price-insensitive buyers — is the same buyer cohort that set the $4,150–$4,218 technical support floor during the June correction, and the record reading entering the FOMC week places the fundamental demand case at its strongest recorded level as gold holds near $4,309.

headline: TECK'S $23M LA COIPITA EARN-IN HITS 747m @ 0.69% Cu IN ARGENTINA PORPHYRY — NEW YARETAS SUR ZONE ADDS 42m @ 1.03% Cu, 0.63 g/t Au
source_name: Junior Mining Network / AbraSilver Resource Corp. (TSX: ABRA)
snippet: AbraSilver Resource Corp. released assay results from the 2026 Teck Resources-funded drill program at La Coipita copper-gold-molybdenum project in San Juan Province, Argentina on June 15, 2026. Hole DDH-LC26-010 returned the project's strongest intersection to date: 747.5 metres grading 0.69% Cu, 0.06 g/t Au, and 142 ppm Mo from 84.5m depth. Hole DDH-LC26-011 added 250.6 metres at 0.39% Cu, 0.07 g/t Au, and 119 ppm Mo. Critically, hole DDH-LC26-012 at the previously untested Yaretas Sur target intersected 42 metres grading 1.03% Cu, 0.63 g/t Au, and 41 g/t Ag from 264m — the project's highest gold grade yet and the identification of a new structural trend. Teck has now invested approximately US$23 million across 11,270 metres in 19 holes under its earn-in agreement. A 747m continuously mineralised intercept with a new discovery hole defining a second open trend in the same drill program is the structural setup that precedes a maiden resource estimate at a Teck-backed porphyry — the combination of dimensions, partner quality, and new target generation that defines district-scale potential.

headline: SILVER BREAKS BELOW $70 ON FOMC DAY 1 — BUT SIXTH STRAIGHT DEFICIT OF 46.3Moz MAKES THE DIP A SETUP, NOT A SIGNAL
snippet: Silver fell to $69.91 per troy ounce on June 16, 2026 — breaking below $70 as institutional investors reduced exposure ahead of Kevin Warsh's first FOMC press conference Wednesday afternoon, reversing Monday's 3%+ ceasefire-driven rally to $70.38. Discovery Alert's analysis frames the drop as pre-FOMC positioning against a market whose structural fundamentals are unchanged: the Silver Institute projects a 46.3 million ounce deficit for 2026, the sixth consecutive annual shortfall and the largest yet, with cumulative five-year deficits now exceeding 800 million ounces — more than an entire year of global mine output. Solar panel thrifting reduced expected PV silver demand by approximately 19% to roughly 151 million ounces in 2026 as manufacturers cut silver loadings per cell, yet even that efficiency gain cannot close a deficit built from six years of demand structurally outrunning supply. For retail silver mining investors, pre-FOMC monetarymechanical selling into a structural supply shortage is the recurrent pattern that defines the best re-entry windows in the current cycle.

headline: FORTUNE BAY + MANHATTAN URANIUM SPUD MURMAC — 5,000m TARGETING 25 ATHABASCA BASIN CONDUCTORS NEAR URANIUM CITY
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Fortune Bay Corp. (TSXV: FOR) + Manhattan Uranium Discovery Corp. (TSXV: MANU)
snippet: Fortune Bay Corp. and Manhattan Uranium Discovery Corp. announced June 16, 2026 that diamond drilling has commenced at the Murmac Uranium Project near Uranium City, northern Saskatchewan — with drilling underway on the first 15 of up to 25 priority targets in the fully funded 5,000-metre summer program. Manhattan Uranium funds the program; Fortune Bay operates it under an option agreement. Murmac's graphitic conductor corridors share the structural signature of Athabasca Basin basement-hosted uranium deposits, with prior drilling confirming mineralization including 8.40 metres grading 0.30% U3O8 (including 1.20 metres at 1.79% U3O8) with individual assays reaching 13.80% U3O8 over 0.10 metres. At uranium spot of $86/lb and long-term contract prices at $91.50/lb — with utilities accelerating contracting ahead of the January 2028 US-Russia import ban — Murmac's 25-target basin-margin program near Uranium City represents one of the most active multi-target drill campaigns entering the Athabasca Basin's summer exploration season.

headline: BARTON GOLD ADDS 10,500m TO TUNKILLIA PHASE 2 — 40,000m TOTAL TARGETS A$1.3BN STARTER PIT FREE CASH AHEAD OF YEAR-END PFS
snippet: Barton Gold Holdings Limited (ASX: BGD) expanded its Phase 2 resource upgrade drilling campaign at the Tunkillia Gold Project in South Australia on June 15, 2026, adding 10,500 metres to bring the total Phase 2 program to approximately 40,000 metres, following an 18,900m Phase 1 reverse circulation program completed in late 2025. The campaign is focused on infilling the S1 and S2 high-value starter pits, which in Tunkillia's May 2025 Optimised Scoping Study were modelled to produce 365,000 oz gold and 923,000 oz silver generating A$1.3 billion in operating free cash flow over approximately 27 months. A Pre-Feasibility Study is targeted before end of 2026, with a Mining Lease application and project finance discussions in 2027. Tunkillia is in the Gawler Craton — South Australia's historically underexplored gold district — and the S1/S2 starter pit provides a high-free-cash-flow early-production path that positions the project well against the current $4,300+ gold price environment and the growing appetite for ASX-listed mid-stage gold developers with defined near-term PFS milestones.

headline: HERAEUS: PRECIOUS METALS RALLY ON IRAN DEAL FACES RATE HIKE HEADWIND — DECEMBER HIKE ODDS STILL AT 70% ENTERING WARSH'S DEBUT
snippet: Heraeus Precious Metals' June 15, 2026 Kitco commentary identifies the analytical gap in the ceasefire-driven precious metals rally: the Iran-US peace deal removed the oil-shock inflation component from May's 4.2% CPI read and deflated geopolitical risk premiums, but December FOMC rate hike probability remains near 70%. Heraeus frames gold at $4,309–$4,338 and silver at $70+ as reflecting the energy/geopolitical premium deflation — not yet the structural monetary easing that would eliminate the remaining rate hike risk. The pivotal variable is Wednesday's dot plot: if Warsh removes or dilutes the 'further firming may be appropriate' forward guidance language, the gold:silver ratio — sitting at 61.7 on June 15 — could compress toward 55:1 as silver's dual monetary and industrial sensitivity amplifies the response. If the dot plot is unchanged, Heraeus identifies the $4,242–$4,309 band as the level that defines whether the ceasefire move was a head-fake or a genuine regime shift for the precious metals complex into Q3 2026.

headline: GOLD FLAT, SILVER BELOW $70, PGMS MIXED — FULL PRECIOUS METALS COMPLEX SQUARES POSITIONS FOR WARSH'S FOMC DEBUT WEDNESDAY
snippet: Investing News Network's June 16, 2026 precious metals price update documents a broad-based cautious tone across the full complex as Kevin Warsh's inaugural two-day FOMC meeting opens: gold held near $4,309 — flat from the post-ceasefire $4,338 high — silver fell approximately 1% to $69.91, and platinum and palladium showed mixed positioning with no directional conviction. The pattern of metals stable-to-soft on FOMC Day 1 after a 5-day rally is historically consistent with institutional pre-announcement positioning: investors who bought the ceasefire move reduce length ahead of the press conference to hedge against a hawkish dot plot surprise, then re-add if Wednesday's statement delivers no rate hike upgrade. For junior mining investors, the June 16 price action is informational rather than directional — the binary event is Wednesday afternoon's press conference and dot plot release, which at 97.4% rate-hold probability will be entirely about the forward guidance language that determines the Q3 2026 precious metals bias.
